def decode(encoded):
    # First reverse the encoded string
    reversed_encoded = encoded[::-1]
    KEY = "orbit"
    out = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed_encoded):
        shift = ord(KEY[i % len(KEY)]) - ord("a")
        # Reverse the encoding: subtract (shift + i) mod 26
        decoded_char = chr((ord(ch) - ord("a") - shift - i) % 26 + ord("a"))
        out.append(decoded_char)
    return "".join(out)

result = decode("kkbeqsz")
print(result)

        out.append(chr((ord(ch) - ord("a") + shift + i) % 26 + ord("a")))
    return "".join(reversed(out))

print("Verification:", encode(result))
